entities.name: PMID:25098818
observations: Retrospective single-surgeon RARP cohort of 815 men after exclusions; small prostate defined as specimen weight <31 g.
In the <31-g subgroup, ≥3 positive preoperative biopsy cores independently predicted PSM after multivariable adjustment (OR 2.52, P=0.043).

entities.name: PMID:24807736
observations: Cohort of 3,227 men undergoing open, robotic, or laparoscopic radical prostatectomy; small prostate defined as volume <29 mL.

In the robotic subgroup, small prostate volume predicted positive basal margins (OR 4.5, P<0.001), while positive apical biopsy predicted apical margins (OR 2.2, P=0.041); total positive-core number was not reported as an independent predictor.

entities.name: PMID:35260742
observations: Cohort of 520 men with MRI-localized prostate cancer undergoing nerve-sparing radical prostatectomy; PSM occurred in 166 (31.9%).
PSM cases had more positive biopsy cores than margin-negative cases (mean 4.1 vs 3.4, P=0.003), but reported multivariable associations emphasized biopsy location rather than total core number.

entities.name: Small prostate core predictor
observations: In the most directly relevant RARP cohort, ≥3 positive preoperative biopsy cores independently predicted PSM in prostates <31 g (OR 2.52, P=0.043).
Evidence for a continuous dose-response relationship or replication across multiple exclusively RARP cohorts is limited.
